resources.string: Patch notes
Update history
Short notes on what changed and how to use it. Tap a version to read more.
What’s new
Got it
Love ya, Mara <3
Stronger transcription for your lectures
With love\nYour Danny~

I’ve added a new Lecture mode with a stronger offline recognizer. It produced much clearer Romanian text in my tests with the same audio. The old recognizer is still available as Compatibility mode.

Before recording or importing, choose Lecture mode at the top of Library. It recognises Romanian. The language selector is used in Compatibility mode.

To try it on a saved recording, open the lecture → More → Transcribe again. This creates a separate transcript and keeps your original text and corrections.

Numbers and medical terms can still be wrong. Tap a passage to listen and hold it to correct the text. Lecture mode keeps the audio for checking.

This update is a larger download because it includes the new model. Recordings stay on your tablet. Send me a problem report in our chat if anything looks wrong.
Clearer transcription and visible progress bar!
I love youuuu\nDanny~

I fixed a problem that could skip parts of your speech. Transcription now continues across recording sections to avoid wasteful tiny jobs. Difficult speech gets a limited extra check some words may still be wrong but the quality should have been improved overall.

Before recording or importing, tap Lecture language at the top of Library. Choose Romanian, English or Auto. Auto keeps the detected language for that lecture. This is done in order to minimise the confusion and stop the language model from switching languages on the fly.

Open a lecture to see the progress bar and animated working indicator ^w^

Audio is kept when a result needs checking. Existing lectures keep their remaining audio, finished transcripts stay unchanged. Send me a problem report in our chat if anything looks wrong.
A personal note with every update

Every update note now ends with a little message from me, including older notes in Settings → Patch notes. You can always open them again there.\n\nTo send me a transcription problem, open a lecture → Report a problem. Select the part and the audio or text you want to include, then Prepare report → Share report → WhatsApp → our chat.
A small window for new updates

You can now find short update notes in Settings → Patch notes. This window appears once for each new version. Older notes stay in the history.\n\nAlso included: problem reports. Open a lecture → Report a problem, choose a passage or time range, and tick the audio and text you want to include. Tap Prepare report, check the contents, then Share report → WhatsApp → our chat. Nothing is sent automatically.
Send a problem report

A lecture now has a Report a problem button. Choose the whole lecture, a passage or a time range, then add a note or the correct words if you like.

For wrong or missing words, tick Include the selected audio and Include the selected transcript. Both start off. Tap Prepare report to check what is included, then Share report → WhatsApp → our chat. Save a copy keeps the report as a ZIP file.

Stop recording or pause transcription before preparing a report. Your lecture stays in scribe. Deleted audio cannot be attached.
A new look, dark theme and help

scribe has a puffin icon and new colours. Settings → Dark theme switches to darker colours.\n\nSettings → Help explains recording, listening, correcting text and keeping your audio. Menus and help are available in English and Romanian.
The first lecture recorder

Record or import a lecture and get a transcript on your tablet after recording stops. Organise lectures by course, mark important moments and export the text.\n\nTap a text passage to listen to its recording. Hold the passage to correct the words. Check the text before relying on it, especially names and specialist terms.
